{{Wireless adapter |brand=Gemtek |model=WL-250F |revision= |upc= |ean= |asin= |price= |est_release_date= |fcc_date=08/10/2001 |manuf_country=Taiwan |is_manuf=Yes |manuf= |manuf_model= |manuf_rev= |availability= |if=Mini PCI |if_bus_version= |if_connector_type= |form_factor= |vendor_id=104c |device_id=ac50 |subvendor_id= |subdevice_id= |id_string="Wireless LAN", "11Mbps Mini PCI", "Version 01.02", "" |fcc_id=MXF-M900820,MXFM900820,MXF-M900614 |ic_id= |chip1_brand=Harris |chip1_model=HFA3841;HFA3841CN, 0045K 4452540, LUC 1257H; |chip2_brand=Intersil |chip2_model=HFA3861B;HFA3861BIN, M0122A020; |chip3_brand=Intersil |chip3_model=HFA3683A;HFA, 3683AIN, N0123EAAT; |chip4_brand= |chip4_model= |addl_chips=2.4GHz Power Amplifier IC;Intersil;HFA3983;HFA, 3983IV, L0123HEFY;1;SiGe;28-lead EPTSSOP; ,,, I/Q Modulator/Demodulator and Synthesizer;Intersil;HFA3783;HFA3783IN, M0122A023;1;SiGe;48-lead LQFP; ,,, PCI CardBus Controller;Texas Instruments;PCI1410A;PCIbus, PCI1410A, AF 17A3LJJ;1; ,,, Parallel Flash memory (1 Mbit);SST;SST39VF010-90-4C-WH;SST 39VF010, 90-4C-WH, MPF 0108461-D;1; ,,, RAM chip (1 Mbit);TM Tech;T15N1024A;tm tech, 70P, CPT, T15N1024A 0114;2; |accessible_UART=No |flags= |ant_conn=U.FL |802dot11_protocols=b |txchains= |rxchains= |sstreams= |oui=00:90:4B |lin_driver= |win_driver= }} This device uses an HFA3861 MAC, connected to the host via a '''TI''' PCI1410 CardBus controller. It should work w/ '''hostap_cs''' / '''orinoco_cs'''.. but you will need PCMCIA support enabled / available. :The card's PCMCIA device ID is 028a:0002.
"WL-250F Rev.00" is silkscreened on the board in the FCC photos.
It appears to have been the wireless module for an '''EarthWalk''' eBuddy (P/N: 76-090004-00).
